tool.name: Gene Ontology
tool.description: download versioned Gene Ontology reference files
tool.help:
Downloads nine official Gene Ontology reference files in OBO, OWL, JSON, and OFN formats.
The release version is extracted from the downloaded ``go-basic.obo`` file. The data table contains one entry per downloaded Gene Ontology file, including its release version and filename.
Each entry's ``path`` column resolves to the corresponding file. RECAP-PROK Module 4 Functional Comparison uses ``go-basic.obo``.
